Evolution Cycling Saturday Ride

Chicago, IL · Andersonville · Road

No-drop

Evolution Cycling Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Walgreens parking lot, Andersonville. About 50-70 miles, steady, 17-19 mph. No-drop.

For visitors

The route changes week to week and is posted in the club's Discord. There is a coffee stop about halfway. The club's weekday rides are on a break until spring 2027; this Saturday ride and the Sunday ride run in the fall.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17-19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @evolutioncyclingchicago the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Evolution Cycling Saturday Ride group ride

Evolution's long Saturday road ride: 50 to 70 miles at a steady 17 to 19 mph, nobody dropped. The route rotates and the club posts it in Discord. Same Andersonville start as the Sunday ride.
